evidence.text: The dRGT action uses the Einstein-Hilbert term plus m²U, with U=U2+α3 U3+α4 U4. Varying the metric gives Gμν+m²χμν=0; the selected spherical ansatz and reference metric lead to the black-hole solution.

sources.title: Effective metric description of charged black holes

sources.title: Black Hole Remnant in Massive Gravity

evidence.text: The authors solve the cubic horizon equation g(r)=0 and use surface gravity for T=(1+Λr+²+2γr++ε)/(4πr+). Integrating dS=dM/T yields S=πr+². The reported heat capacity is C=2πr+²(1+Λr+²+2γr++ε)/(Λr+²−1−ε).

sources.title: Black Hole Remnant in Massive Gravity

evidence.text: Remnant candidates are obtained by setting T=0 and requiring real positive radius and mass. The displayed branch is Rr=(√(γ²−(1+ε)Λ)−γ)/Λ. The authors also state that the opposite square-root branch can admit remnants and present a positivity contradiction for Λ<0.

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Impose a periodic-scalar winding condition, reduce its kinetic term with the KK connection, and identify the induced covariant derivative. Treat changing the winding sector separately from varying continuous fields within one sector.

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Deform an existing Euclidean pair-production configuration by a flat connection supported on its nontrivial topology. If the action and asymptotic data are unchanged, the original nonzero amplitude supplies the corresponding period-labelled states.

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Differentiate an invariant one-form ansatz in an orthonormal frame, impose a chosen Hodge duality sign, and integrate the resulting radial equation. Asymptotic normalization gives F=r/(r+Nλ²).

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Move to a dual frame with an explicit Chern–Simons term, reduce its selected internal components, and map back. The method requires the flux sectors generated by duality, including non-geometric ones.

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Move to a duality frame where the relevant vector comes from B_2, reduce the known Chern-Simons interaction, and map its coefficient back to the original compactification data. Keep distinct the fields and normalizations in the two frames.

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Reduce the period and its kinetic action together, then inspect wrapped charged configurations in the lower-dimensional theory. A formal instanton phase is insufficient unless backreaction, infrared convergence, and boundary conditions permit the configuration.

evidence.text: Rescale each radial measurement by (r/Rref)^3, average within angular patches, then sum patch means with solid-angle weights ΔΩ/(4π). Time bins missing any required patch are discarded; polar patches receive special latitude widths for small angular bins.

sources.title: Phenomenology of magnetic black holes with electroweak-symmetric coronas

evidence.text: How abundant can primordial, nearly extremal magnetic black holes with electroweak-symmetric coronas be, and how can galactic magnetic fields, neutrinos and astrophysical heating constrain them?
